alignments: page title is centered on the canvas horizontal axis while the back group anchors left
summary card uses a left medallion column and a right title/copy/metrics column
filter/sort bar balances a left filter group against a right sort group
all three build cards share fixed left medallion, middle content, right action and bottom metadata columns
primary action buttons align to a common right rail across all build cards
bottom metadata grids use three visually equal columns separated by vertical dividers
main cards and disclaimer share near-common left and right outer bounds
spacingRhythm: major framed regions are separated by approximately 22-32 px vertical gaps after the summary card
build cards repeat a title, badge, body-copy, divider and metadata rhythm
metadata columns use a two-line label/value stack beneath small icons
right action areas pair a large gold button with a smaller simulator link below
dark stone surfaces, bronze clipped frames and gold typography repeat across the page
